$comment: The sing-box release ZoFHub runs as its egress daemon, pinned by SHA-256.
tools/install-singbox.mjs downloads the asset for the build platform from the
URL below and REFUSES it unless its SHA-256 equals the digest committed here,
so what runs is the exact file that was reviewed when this was pinned, not
whatever a release page serves on the day of a build.
The digests are GitHub's own, read from the release API on 2026-11-03:
To move to a newer release: change `version`, replace every digest from the same
API call, and bump the Dockerfile's SINGBOX_VERSION to match (a test fails if the
sing-box is GPL-3.0 and is NOT vendored into this repository. The binary is
downloaded into .singbox/ (git-ignored) at build time and run as its own
process; ZoFHub is not a derivative work of it and is not affiliated with it.
